name: CC
desc: Labs agent that coordinates a family's calendars and tasks
desc_zh: 帮家庭统筹日历和待办的 Google Labs 智能体
solves: Household logistics live in six different chats; CC keeps one shared calendar and briefs every member.
solves_zh: 家庭事务散在六七个群聊里，CC 维护一份共享日历并向每位成员简报。
best_for: Three kids have practice, a form deadline and a dentist visit in the same week.
best_for_zh: 三个孩子同一周有训练、表格截止和牙医预约。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://labs.google/ (current experiments)）。 First date is outside the window. Launched 2025-12-16 as a personal agent in early access (waitlist, US and Canada). On 2026-09-17, inside the window, Google relaunched it as a group agent for up to six family members (US, waitlist for new users). Second source is not independent media. 首次公开日期来源：https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/google-labs/cc-ai-agent/ 官网未直接确认（redirect->https://labs.google.com/cc/）。
